message.reasoning:
I am ready to play Monopoly.

I am p2 with $337 on BOARDWALK. I paid $50 rent to p4. My properties include MEDITERRANEAN_AVENUE, CONNECTICUT_AVENUE, B_O_RAILROAD, VENTNOR_AVENUE, PACIFIC_AVENUE, and NORTH_CAROLINA_AVENUE. I need Pennsylvania Avenue for a green monopoly. p1 has $655 and is on PACIFIC_AVENUE.

p1 holds a complete orange set and can build houses. p3 has three railroads and several other properties. p4 owns STATES_AVENUE.

I am correcting the color assignments. Indiana Avenue is red, not orange. New York Avenue belongs to p4, completing the orange set with p1's St. James and Tennessee.

I now see p1 holds only two of the three orange properties. p4 owns New York Avenue, completing the set. I have two of three greens and am missing Pennsylvania Avenue.

Baltic, Oriental, Virginia, Kentucky, Atlantic, and Park Place are unowned. I will not sell B&O to p3 because that would raise rent to $200. Ventnor must stay to block p1's yellow set. Connecticut is a backup plan. I can barely afford Pennsylvania Avenue at $320. No builds are possible without a monopoly.

I cannot trade for a monopoly right now. The missing pieces are mostly still in the bank.

I cannot trade for a useful property. p4 will not sell New York Avenue to complete p1's orange set, and that would be dangerous. Boardwalk alone is worth little without Park Place.

I will end my turn. No trade or mortgage improves my position.
